data.name: Query_GetRequisitionMRPRecordByItemID
data.value: declare @ProductQuantity int set @ProductQuantity = @Quantity select [TransactionDetailID],[SerialNo],CategoryID,ItemCategoryID,CategoryName,ItemID,[ItemDescription],Item,TransactionUOMID, ABS(TransactionQuantity) as TransactionQuantity,OldItemPrice,CurrentStock,LastConsumption,LastPurchasePrice,EstimatedPOItemPrice,Amount,TransactionCost,CostCenterID, IncurredOnID,PrimaryQuantity,ReasonLookup,DistributionAccountCOA,EncumbranceAccountCOA,EncumbranceAmount,CurrencyConversionRate, CurrencyConversionType,QuantityAdjusted,EmployeeCode,DepartmentID,ReceivingDocument,TransferTransactionLookup,SourceCode,SourceLineID, VendorLotNumber,ShipmentNumber,WayBillAirBill,FreightCode,NoofContainers,ValueChange,PercentageChange,ProjectID,ReservationLookup, CustomerID,InvoiceFlag,PriorCost,SourceHeaderID,CostCenterName,UOMName,CustomerName,IncurredDescription,CurrencyID,Description, CurrencyName,ProjectName,Remarks,Action from ( SELECT -1 as [TransactionDetailID], -1 as [SerialNo], AS_RecipeDetail.ItemCategory as CategoryID, AS_RecipeDetail.ItemCategory as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName as CategoryName, AS_RecipeDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.Description as [ItemDescription], INV_Item.Description as Item, 1 as [TransactionUOMID], ( select IsNull(Sum(Case when Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'No Impact' then 0 else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity END), 0) As SumOfQuantityInStock from INV_StockTransactionDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader On INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType On SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID where INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = INV_Item.ItemID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = 1 And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 And SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) - (Quantity * @ProductQuantity) as [TransactionQuantity], -- empty column 0 as OldItemPrice, 0 as CurrentStock, 0 as LastConsumption, 0 as LastPurchasePrice, 0 as EstimatedPOItemPrice, 0 as Amount, 0 as TransactionCost, 0 as CostCenterID, 0 as IncurredOnID, 0 as PrimaryQuantity, '' as ReasonLookup, '' as DistributionAccountCOA, '' as EncumbranceAccountCOA, '' as EncumbranceAmount, '' as CurrencyConversionRate, '' as CurrencyConversionType, '' as QuantityAdjusted, '' as EmployeeCode, '' as DepartmentID, '' as ReceivingDocument, '' as TransferTransactionLookup, '' as SourceCode, '' as SourceLineID, '' as VendorLotNumber, '' as ShipmentNumber, '' as WayBillAirBill, '' as FreightCode, '' as NoofContainers, '' as ValueChange, '' as PercentageChange, '' as ProjectID, '' as ReservationLookup, '' as CustomerID, 'false' as InvoiceFlag, 0 as PriorCost, '' as SourceHeaderID, '' as CostCenterName, '' as UOMName, '' as CustomerName, '' as IncurredDescription, '' as CurrencyID, '' as Description, '' as CurrencyName, '' as ProjectName, '' as Remarks, 'Add' as Action From AS_RecipeDetail inner join AS_RecipeHeader on AS_RecipeHeader.RecipeID = AS_RecipeDetail.RecipeID AND AS_RecipeHeader.CompanyID = AS_RecipeDetail.CompanyID inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = AS_RecipeDetail.ItemID --And INV_Item.CompanyID = AS_RecipeDetail.CompanyID inner join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = AS_RecipeDetail.ItemCategory --and INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = AS_RecipeDetail.CompanyID inner join SET_ItemCatalog on SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID and SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive = 1 and SET_ItemCatalog.Status = 1 Where AS_RecipeDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AS_RecipeHeader.itemID = @ItemID ) fintab where fintab.[TransactionQuantity] <0
